{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat,
         CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr,
         oi.price AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
), agg AS (
  SELECT cat,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q1' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_q1,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q2' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_q2
  FROM q GROUP BY cat
), both AS (
  SELECT cat, gmv_q1, gmv_q2, gmv_q2 - gmv_q1 AS diff
  FROM agg WHERE gmv_q1 > 0 AND gmv_q2 > 0
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both) AS common_categories,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both WHERE diff < 0) AS declining_categories,
  (SELECT cat FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_category,
  (SELECT diff FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_amount,
  (SELECT gmv_q1 FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_q1,
  (SELECT gmv_q2 FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_q2;"}

  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
),
buyers AS (
  SELECT customer_state, count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS buyers FROM q2 GROUP BY customer_state
),
gmv AS (
  SELECT q.customer_state, sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM q2 q JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE q.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  GROUP BY q.customer_state
),
j AS (
  SELECT b.customer_state, b.buyers, g.gmv, g.gmv / b.buyers AS gmv_per_buyer
  FROM buyers b JOIN gmv g USING(customer_state)
)
SELECT
  max(CASE WHEN customer_state='SP' THEN buyers END) AS sp_buyers,
  max(CASE WHEN customer_state='RJ' THEN buyers END) AS rj_buyers,
  max(CASE WHEN customer_state='SP' THEN gmv END) AS sp_gmv,
  max(CASE WHEN customer_state='RJ' THEN gmv END) AS rj_gmv,
  max(CASE WHEN customer_state='SP' THEN gmv END) - max(CASE WHEN customer_state='RJ' THEN gmv END) AS gmv_diff,
  max(CASE WHEN customer_state='SP' THEN buyers END) - max(CASE WHEN customer_state='RJ' THEN buyers END) AS buyers_diff,
  round(max(CASE WHEN customer_state='SP' THEN buyers END)::numeric / max(CASE WHEN customer_state='RJ' THEN buyers END), 4) AS buyers_ratio,
  round(max(CASE WHEN customer_state='SP' THEN gmv END) / max(CASE WHEN customer_state='RJ' THEN gmv END), 4) AS gmv_ratio,
  max(CASE WHEN customer_state='SP' THEN gmv_per_buyer END) AS sp_gmv_per_buyer,
  max(CASE WHEN customer_state='RJ' THEN gmv_per_buyer END) AS rj_gmv_per_buyer,
  round(max(CASE WHEN customer_state='SP' THEN gmv_per_buyer END) / max(CASE WHEN customer_state='RJ' THEN gmv_per_buyer END), 4) AS gmv_per_buyer_ratio
FROM j;"}

j AS (SELECT v.order_id, it.price, it.freight, pa.pay FROM v JOIN it USING(order_id) JOIN pa USING(order_id))
SELECT

  round(100 * (sum(pay) - sum(price)) / sum(price), 2) AS payment_over_item_pct,

  sum(CASE WHEN pay > price + freight THEN pay - price - freight ELSE 0 END) AS overpay_amount,
